title: Miami Going-Out Picks, GTA VI Week
igCaption:
GTA VI week starts in Wynwood, and @iiipoints is in the mix.
Nov. 10 to 21, Miami and Fort Lauderdale, $0 to $298

Sources: Secret Miami, Miami New Times

#MiamiEvents #MiamiNightlife #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: The official Grand Theft Auto VI festival is landing in Wynwood this month.

Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival takes over Mana Wynwood on Saturday, Nov. 21. Rockstar and PlayStation announced two stages, produced by the team behind III Points. Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin, Tainy, Rauw Alejandro and Justice are on the bill.

scenes.text: Fans must enter the lottery by Tuesday, Nov. 10 at 4 p.m. Selected entries get an SMS code by 7 p.m., then the sale opens Wednesday at noon. The event is 17 and older.

scenes.text: Doja Cat brings the Ma Vie World Tour to Kaseya Center on Wednesday, Nov. 11. Latto is the special guest. The show starts at 7:30 p.m., and tickets list from $39 to $159. If you’re there, check NEAR later and see who else was at Kaseya.

scenes.text: Emo Orchestra plays Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale on Tuesday, Nov. 10. The Spill Canvas joins a full orchestra for songs by Taking Back Sunday, Fall Out Boy, A Day to Remember and The Used. The show starts at 6 p.m. Tickets cost $44.

scenes.text: Common joins Nu Deco Ensemble at the Adrienne Arsht Center at 8 p.m., with tickets from $70 to $298. NightGarden opens at Fairchild from 6 to 10 p.m., with real ice-skating under the palms.
